entry.summary: Overseas France is outside the Schengen area: a Schengen visa doesn't cover it. Australians are reported visa-free for short stays (Smartraveller says so for French Polynesia and New Caledonia, 90 days in 180).
entry.next_check: Confirm the rule for this territory on France-Visas.

conditional: Yellow fever certificate: Proof of vaccination against yellow fever is required for travellers aged 1 year or over, arriving from countries at risk for yellow fever transmission, and for travellers having transited for more than 12 hours through an airport of countries at risk for yellow fever transmission
